scope: Read-only repair review of the official Prisma PostgreSQL adapter adoption and bounded application driver; repository changes, CI/build and release/provider validation belong to root.

observations.interpretation: Timer-only pg public client.end forced socket closure and transaction rejection; next transaction used a fresh connection.
No queued SELECT reached the stalled socket; acquisition expired after 2 seconds and pool.end completed after active transport close.

Exact repository helper retained Client subclass instrumentation after adapter-created pool recreation and permitted subsequent queries; concurrent raw query shutdown cleared actual sockets and queued acquisitions.
Full URL hostname verification and DNS SNI were preserved; certificate chain verification remained enabled. CA and private key belonged only to a temporary local synthetic certificate.

result.model_40001: PrismaClientKnownRequestError P2034 in both native and adapter

observations.interpretation: Existing model serialization retries remain compatible; raw serialization/deadlock and model deadlock retry gaps predate this repair.

result.same_client_post_shutdown_reuse_error: GenericFailure: Engine is not yet connected (even after explicit $connect)

observations.interpretation: Terminal shutdown during an active interactive transaction uses the default approximately 5-second Prisma transaction deadline. All transport/pool work drains, but safe reuse of that same client is not established. This failed stress harness is retained as a limit, not a passing test.
Final helper cleared the deadline for pg Query emitter completion, retained the healthy socket beyond3 seconds, and successfully queried again on that same connection.

concerns_resolved.concern: pg URL parameters override an explicit strict SSL object
concerns_resolved.evidence: Direct constructor probe reproduced ssl=0 -> false and ssl=no-verify -> rejectUnauthorized:false. Final helper removes all query parameters; runtime and production gate reject unsupported/ambiguous settings.

concerns_resolved.concern: Prisma sslcert and pg sslcert have different meanings
concerns_resolved.resolution: Certificate URL aliases are rejected rather than forwarded. Runtime uses platform trust store and the explicitly verified URL host. Private provider CA/client identity configuration is not supported by this repair and requires a separately reviewed extension.

concerns_resolved.concern: Strict pg8.20 TLS alone can verify localhost instead of an IP URL host
concerns_resolved.evidence: Original direct pg strict config accepted a trusted DNS:localhost certificate with host127.0.0.1; final explicit tls.checkServerIdentity(expectedHost,cert) rejects the mismatch.

concerns_resolved.concern: Adapter schema option does not set raw-query search_path
concerns_resolved.resolution: Final helper supplies the same literal schema to adapter and quoted startup search_path; double quotes are doubled, whitespace/backslash escaped, names constrained to nonempty/NUL-free <=63 bytes, special $user and pg_temp aliases rejected.

concerns_resolved.concern: Event-only instrumentation is lost during external pool disposal/recreation
concerns_resolved.evidence: Direct factory dispose/connect reproduced replacement connect listener count0; final config retains BoundedPostgresClient, and exact runtime post-disposal3-second deadline/recovery passed.

concerns_resolved.concern: Version mismatch or unbounded connection pool defaults
concerns_resolved.resolution: Client, CLI and adapter are exactly6.19.3, pg exactly8.20.0. Explicit connection/acquisition timeout2s, query transport deadline3s, pool connection_limit1..10 are enforced.

durable_callers.source_review: HealthService shares underlying readiness checks and clears in-flight work after query settles. PaymentOperationsService catches drain failures, resets running in finally, retries later scans, and preserves durable idempotency keys/leases when writes or commit outcomes are uncertain.
durable_callers.limitation: No live payment provider, real payment write/commit, or production readiness endpoint was exercised by this verifier. Operations agent/root owns service regression and final CI.

limitations: All traffic was loopback to minimal owned PostgreSQL wire/TLS fixtures; no real credentials or provider/account traffic.

Wire fixtures exercise installed drivers and issued SQL messages; they are not a database emulator and do not establish real row rollback, schema permissions, recovery scans against PostgreSQL, or production TLS.

Custom-schema startup escaping and special-alias guards were reviewed against primary PostgreSQL documentation and configuration probes; no real PostgreSQL server was available for server-side schema execution.
Socket closure after a write/COMMIT leaves the outcome uncertain; callers must not infer rollback from timeout and must retain durable retry/idempotency safeguards.
Interactive transaction concurrent shutdown is terminal and approximately5s, with same-client post-shutdown reuse unverified/failed in the retained stress harness.
Native Prisma CLI/schema-engine network deadlines remain a separate deployment/migration concern; the helper bounds application pg traffic only.
Root owns final lint/typecheck/tests/build/audit and source-state reconciliation.
Independent harnesses ran with the local node executable v25.8.0; the supported Node >=22.13.0/container runtime requires root final validation.
conclusion: Official adapter adoption fixes the accepted-query transport hang while preserving verified TLS, reserved transaction ownership, ordinary serialization retries, bounded acquisition, queue cleanup and ordinary pool recreation. Accept within the recorded terminal-shutdown, CLI and service-backed validation limits.
